findings.message: 4 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Transport keys are not reasoning interfaces." → 3 lines (6 words, 92.2px); "One citation score tells the wrong story." → 3 lines (7 words, 92.2px); "Reasoning-budget gains did not replicate." → 3 lines (5 words, 92.2px); "The production case rests on measured cost, bind" → 3 lines (13 words, 43.2px, a paragraph set above 36px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 0 real photograph(s) or clip(s); the rest are interface fragments.
findings.fix: Add two or more real pictures of the customer's world from scripts/assets.mjs, not stock of people at laptops.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The margins differ: 0px on the left, 32px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 5 sections keep all their content on one side and leave 69% of the width empty: div.metric-copy.reveal-up (left 940px empty); div.study-copy.reveal-up (left 995px empty); div.mechanism-head.reveal-up (left 995px empty); div.entities-copy.reveal-up (left 995px empty)
findings.fix: Use the whole width the page has set up: put the section's picture, its second column, its list or its figure in the empty half, or set the text larger across the grid. Empty space must be placed, with something on each side of it.

findings.message: 4 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 412px at 10628px; 412px at 12288px; 384px at 14600px; 408px at 16324px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 487px of the width empty: "500 / 500".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 16px from the left edge but only to 36px from the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).
